productArea.name: Translations
productArea.scope: Select a language and entity tab, search and page through translation progress, and translate fields and attribute values using individual, bulk, and rich text editors. Edit translated content only, leaving source records and their configuration to their own areas.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Translations, select a language, and use its category, product, collection, promotion, voucher, model, attribute, shipping method, and structure tabs. Open an entity for field translations and follow product links to variant translations.
